ballots.name: Ines
ballots.reason: Recorded, read-only access does not prevent misinterpretation of private scratch notes, and allowing access merely because a member was not invited undermines trustworthy working memory.

ballots.name: Omar
ballots.reason: Recorded, read-only access within the project is preferable to deciding without an occupied agent’s working context, despite the risks of interpreting provisional notes.

ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: The motion as written lacks decision links in the minutes and includes a "was not invited" clause that exceeds the motivating case, so I cannot verify that scratch-note information was used fairly or detect cherry-picking, which means the audit trail is insufficient for accountability.
